name: Porsche 911 Carrera 4S
author: Karol Miklas
scope: Licensed visual reference, model year unspecified. Component groups follow the supplied geometry. No dealer VIN, inventory, engineering dimensions or engine internals are represented.

components.label: Body panels
components.description: The painted body surfaces define the Carrera 4S silhouette. Hide the body to inspect the other supplied model pieces; this asset does not contain a detailed engine or complete cabin.
components.question: Ask the showroom team which exterior colors and body options are available on the exact vehicle you are considering.

components.label: Front wheels & tires
components.description: Both front wheels are supplied as one group with separate metal, rubber and trim meshes. Rotate or isolate this group to examine the wheel and tire surfaces. Tire size and condition must be checked on the actual car.
components.question: For a used car, ask about tire age, tread depth, matching tires and wheel damage.

components.label: Rear wheels & tires
components.description: Both rear wheels are supplied as one group. This is visual geometry, so displayed proportions should not be used to order wheels or tires.
components.question: Ask Porsche service to confirm the correct front and rear tire specifications for the vehicle's VIN.

components.label: Windows & windshield
components.description: The source model separates its glazed surfaces. Inspect their shape and visibility; this visual asset cannot establish the actual car's tint, glass condition or acoustic-glass equipment.
components.question: Check the vehicle's glass, windshield chips and visibility during your inspection and test drive.

components.label: Front fascia & lights
components.description: The source's front bumper groups contain trim and lighting surfaces. Select or isolate them to inspect their design. A rendered light does not verify which lighting package a dealer vehicle has.
components.question: Ask the team to demonstrate the exact vehicle's headlights and confirm its equipment list.

components.label: Supporting details & trim
components.description: This group preserves the source's remaining trim, badges and supporting surfaces. The publisher's generic node names do not establish a complete mechanical or cabin assembly.
components.question: Use the exact vehicle's equipment list and inspection to confirm details that matter to you.

components.label: Underbody surface
components.description: The model includes a simple underbody surface. It is not an engineering cutaway and does not show verified suspension, drivetrain or engine internals.
components.question: For a used vehicle, request a professional underbody inspection for damage, leaks and corrosion.

ignored_meshes.reason: Source presentation backdrop: flat ground plane, not a vehicle component. Preserved in original GLB; hidden in viewer.
